##  · D3-q-frames — D3: netd-to-ipd frames by send+transfer need WIRE's kind column

Status: **resolved** · Assigned to: Orchestrator · Revision: 2

*Resolved in an earlier workspace; reopen it if the code has changed since.*

Evidence: Ruled on D3-plan (the Kind column; frames as sends); implemented in ae5bb4af5 and merged with D3 at dc3c8aab1.

### D3 implementer · Question

Event: `b25d7464f4320cedeaac487273ff33fc` · 2026-09-24T20:18:42Z

> **Spec.**
> - PLAN attack suite: "Bob parks 64 lent calls at ipd ... and ipd still receives netd's frames (sends)".
> - Answer 81: at MAX_OPEN_CALLS, receive "still delivering sends".
> - WIRE: "Every milestone 1 typed message is a call ... a kind column is added when a protocol first needs a send (a transfer)."
> 
> D3 is that first protocol.
> 
> **Proposal.**
> - Add a Kind column (call | send) to WIRE tables, default call when absent so the existing tables are unchanged.
> - Extend redoubt-wire-gen additively. This is merged W1/W2 code, with drift checks and regenerated codecs.
> - ipd's ninep table gets `17 | send | frame | frame: bytes | -`, accepted only from the ingress badge minted for netd, with a 1-page transfer.
> - tx stays a call: netif `2 transmit`.
> 
> **Why not the alternatives.**
> - **ipd pulls frames with a parked call to netd.** ipd would then need a second thread and either a transfer within one process (open question 138) or unsafe shared memory between threads.
> - **netd sends from its serving thread.** That deadlocks against ipd's transmit call.
> 
> **Decision needed.** Approve the kind column, the generator change and the WIRE sentence edit, with an ANSWERS record.
